commands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '125,220p' Strata/Languages/Core/OldExpressions.lean; sed -n '248,303p' Strata/Languages/Core/OldExpressions.lean; sed -n '2010,2110p' Strata/Transform/CallElimCorrect.lean; sed -n '2840,2965p' Strata/Transform/CallElimCorrect.lean; rg -n 'def .*getVars|theorem.*[Ss]ubset|def IsOldExpr|inductive IsOldExpr|def oldVar' Strata/DL/Lambda/LExpr.lean Strata/Languages/Core/OldExpressions.lean"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,105p' Strata/Languages/Core/OldExpressions.lean; sed -n '285,335p' Strata/DL/Lambda/LExpr.lean; sed -n '1,85p' Strata/Transform/CallElimCorrect.lean; rg -n 'append_subset_append|subset_append' "'$(lean --print-prefix)/src/lean/Init/Data/List -g '"'*.lean'; cat lean-toolchain"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n '(def|abbrev) (List\\.)?Subset|Subset\\.(refl|append)|append_subset|namespace List|def getVars|instance.*HasVarsPure' Strata/DL/Util/ListUtils.lean Strata/DL/Imperative Strata/Languages/Core -g '*.lean'; sed -n '1,165p' Strata/DL/Util/ListUtils.lean; sed -n '1,200p' check_candidate.py"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n '(Subset|subset_def)' Strata/Transform/CallElimCorrect.lean | head -50; rg -n 'attribute.*simp.*(Subset|append_subset|subset_def)|def List.Subset|def Subset' Strata .lake/packages -g '*.lean' | head -65; sed -n '1,65p' Strata/Languages/Core/Expressions.lean; sed -n '1,28p' "'$(lean --print-prefix)/src/lean/Init/Data/List/Sublist.lean; rg -n '"'subset_refl|Subset.refl|def Subset' "'$(lean --print-prefix)/src/lean/Init/Data/List/Basic.lean $(lean --print-prefix)/src/lean/Init/Data/List/Lemmas.lean'

/bin/bash -lc "cat > candidate.lean <<'EOF'
open OldExpressions in
theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  intro h
  change extractOldExprVars post ⊆ Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars post
  induction h <;>
    simp_all [extractOldExprVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
  case app fn e m hfn he hf ihfn ihe =>
    unfold extractOldExprVars
    split
    · simp [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
    · next hfalse =>
      have h := hf IsOldPred.oldPred
      cases h
      exact (hfalse rfl).elim
    · simp_all
EOF
python check_candidate.py candidate.lean"

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('candidate.lean')
s = p.read_text().replace('      exact (hfalse rfl).elim', '      exfalso\\n      apply hfalse\\n      rfl')
p.write_text(s)
PY
python check_candidate.py candidate.lean"

method_note: Shell commands and visible correctness outcomes only; no reasoning text. rg/sed is a literal command-presence indicator, not a semantic retrieval score.
